families.page_title: Annexe F: UKHSA incident response roles
evidence_points: The annex describes national and local or regional incident-response roles.
A Strategic Response Director provides strategic direction for enhanced or severe responses.
An Incident Director leads tactical response and is the senior decision maker for standard incidents.
Incident-management cells are led by appropriately trained cell leads.
Scientific and technical advisory and outbreak-control roles support multi-agency response.
Roles require defined competence, agreement, training and continuing development.
